_meta.adr: ADR-037 modular register fragment + ADR-048 semantic references + ADR-051 semantic-object-handoff + ADR-031 declarative business logic — never edit shillinq_register.json
_meta.description: kind: config — shillinq consume side of the cross-app quote → contract → AR-invoice handoff chain (ADR-051). Declares (1) configuration.implements markers for the four canonical finance kinds, exactly one deployed schema per kind: ARInvoice=ns#Invoice (+schema.org/Invoice), Contract=ns#Contract, SalesOrder=ns#SalesOrder (+schema.org/Order; ns#SalesOrder carries no kind contract at OR HEAD, so marker only), Quote=ns#Quote; (2) handoffContract provider bindings (the landed consume-side dialect: contract field → own property, validated by OR's HandoffContractBindingValidator) on Contract for ns#Contract and ARInvoice for ns#Invoice; (3) x-openregister-handoff emitter entries — H1 quote-accepted-to-contract on Quote (trigger lifecycle:accepted, per the hydra order-chain contract) and H2 contract-to-initial-invoice on Contract (trigger MANUAL: the landed v1 dialect has no condition grammar, so a lifecycle:active auto-trigger would also draft AR invoices for inbound/purchase contracts — manual is the narrowest safe scope per the change's Open Question 3; recurring billing stays with RecurringInvoiceProfile); (4) provenance pointer properties sourceQuoteReference / sourceContractReference — scalar URN shillinq:<schema>:<businessNumber> written by the emitters' source template because the notification created-filter grammar is scalar-only (objects string-cast to ''), while UUID-level provenance additionally lives in the engine-written handoff:<id>:originated-from relations and audit rows; (5) handoff-received notification rules (ADR-031 canonical dialect, trigger created + filter provenance-non-empty, recipients object-acl manage + shillinq-finance, bilingual metadata-only subjects); (6) two DEMO seeds making the draft-arrival, provenance rendering and notification condition verifiable without pipelinq. Everything is keyed to kind URIs — the abstract-order-primitive consolidation re-points this ONE file; no Order-slug schema is declared and no property is added to the colliding Order declarations.

sourceQuoteReference.title: Source Quote Reference
sourceQuoteReference.description: Handoff provenance pointer to the quote this contract originated from (ADR-051; bound to the ns#Contract kind-contract field `source`). Scalar URN `shillinq:quote:<quoteNumber>` written by the quote-accepted-to-contract emitter mapping — scalar because the notification created-filter grammar string-casts objects to ''. UUID-level provenance additionally lives in the engine-written `handoff:<id>:originated-from` relation and the immutable audit trail. Null/absent for operator-created contracts.

sourceContractReference.title: Source Contract Reference
sourceContractReference.description: Handoff provenance pointer to the contract this AR invoice originated from (ADR-051; bound to the ns#Invoice kind-contract field `source`). Scalar URN `shillinq:contract:<contractNumber>` written by the contract-to-initial-invoice emitter mapping — scalar because the notification created-filter grammar string-casts objects to ''. UUID-level provenance additionally lives in the engine-written `handoff:<id>:originated-from` relation and the immutable audit trail. Null/absent for operator-created invoices.

objects.title: Adviesdiensten Gemeente Voorbeeld (DEMO)
objects.description: DEMO seed data — contract zoals aangemaakt door de ADR-051 quote→contract handoff (H1). De provenance wijst naar een placeholder-offerte (nil-UUID; de bron bestaat niet in een verse omgeving), zodat de handoffReceived-notificatieregel en de draft-aankomst verifieerbaar zijn zonder pipelinq.
